purpose: Sourced C4/C6 variation descriptions and responsibility checks. No expected coverage or PASS results are encoded.
source_boundaries: Appendix B describes conceptual baseline responsibilities.
Appendix A reports ATAM-derived operational findings and proposed refinements. Those findings are not independent baseline observations.
Descriptions here do not overwrite baseline_components.json or establish implementation support.

baseline_evidence.conceptual_responsibility: Evaluate policy and return a decision with applicable obligations.
baseline_evidence.conceptual_source: Requirements Appendix B, Section A R7 and Table C R7
baseline_evidence.operational_assessment: Table A-0 lists C4.1 Policy Evaluator, C4.2 Policy Registry and C4.3 Decision API; Appendix A reports no C4.4 Obligation Handler.

baseline_evidence.conceptual_responsibility: Enforce need-to-know decisions and applicable masking/filtering obligations before release.
baseline_evidence.conceptual_source: Requirements Appendix B, Section A R7 and Table C R7
baseline_evidence.operational_assessment: Appendix A describes C6.6 as specified but not enforced at gateway instances.

change.name: Obligation Handler
change.responsibility: Prepare applicable obligations for attachment to the policy decision, including masking and time-bound constraints.

variations.boundary: Preparation or attachment at C4 is distinct from applying transformations to released data at C6/C15.
variations.interface_effect: Decision response must carry obligations interpretable by the enforcement path; exact payload changes are unspecified.
variations.state_effect: No new persistent state owner is established by these refinement descriptions.

change.name: Data Minimizer
change.responsibility: Apply the specified minimisation capability at every gateway instance intercepting relevant requests.

variations.boundary: This changes operational availability of a specified responsibility; it does not newly invent baseline masking/filtering intent.
variations.interface_effect: Must consume applicable obligations and scope consistently with C4/C15. Exact contracts remain unspecified.
variations.state_effect: Request-local decision and enforcement data do not alone establish persistent gateway state.

responsibility_checks.responsibility: Prepare and return policy decision with applicable obligations.
responsibility_checks.required_evidence: Decision preparation evidence, policy/consent correctness and an interpretable response contract.

responsibility_checks.responsibility: Enforce the decision and every applicable obligation before disclosure.
responsibility_checks.required_evidence: Consumer semantics, transformation evidence and unsupported-obligation handling.

responsibility_checks.responsibility: Apply authorized data scope and relevant labels/filters in the modeled access path.
responsibility_checks.required_evidence: Scope interpretation and C6-C15 request/response compatibility.

responsibility_checks.responsibility: Record the access decision and enforcement outcome.

state_checks.documented_ownership: Policy Registry is named; exact storage and consistency rules remain unspecified.
state_checks.boundary: A registry designation is conceptual evidence, not verified persistence.

state_checks.documented_ownership: Section A.0 explicitly assigns current consent state to C4.2.
state_checks.boundary: Do not infer freshness, synchronization or revocation timing from ownership alone.

state_checks.documented_ownership: Section A.0 assigns issuance and maintenance to C14.
state_checks.boundary: C14's involvement is conditional on the selected consent representation.

state_checks.information: Decision and obligations for the current request
state_checks.boundary: Temporary request context does not require persistent sessions or justify classifying the entire gateway as stateful.

assessment_boundaries: No coverage change can be inferred merely from adding a named subcomponent.
C4_star alone does not prove enforcement; C6_star alone does not prove correct obligation preparation.
Existing reference-model tests consume supplied policy responses and do not test C4's policy evaluation or obligation selection.
Proposed-contract tests remain separate from historical baseline interface assurance.
Operational descriptions inherited from Appendix A cannot count as independent reproduction of its ATAM gaps.
Compatibility and overall coverage require further evidence and may remain undetermined.
